title: fix(configure): ignore invalid userToken
body:
<!--

**Summary**

This PR fixes `configure` widget to ignore invalid userToken.

Although we have fixed nullish user token issues in `insights` middleware, if users still put `null` into `configure` widget, it was passing the `null` as a string to search api. We ignore it from now on.
